articleTitle: Why 'Helping' Around the House Isn't the Same as Sharing It
imageHeadline: You Plan, They Help—Why That's Still Not Equal
imageSubtext: See how to name the invisible work and rebalance it
pinTitle: mental load in relationships why helping isn't the same as sharing household work
pinDescription: If your partner helps when asked but you're the one remembering, planning, and tracking everything, you're carrying the mental load. Learn why that invisible work matters, how to name it in your relationship, and practical ways to rebalance household responsibilities so you're not the default parent or manager.
